surface.vue: Combobox: new props `open: { type: Boolean, default: undefined }` (controlled when not undefined, so v-model:open works) and `defaultOpen: Boolean` (false). Existing events `update:open`, `update:query` unchanged. Exposed methods: element, focus, close, new `show()`.

surface.vanilla: createCombobox options: new `onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void`, `onQueryChange?: (query: string) => void`. Root event hw:change gains two more shapes: detail {open} and detail {query}; the value event keeps detail {value, label}. Controller keeps `open`, `show()`, `close()`.

endState.dom: No element change. aria-expanded and `hidden` on the listbox follow the effective open state: the application's `open` when controlled, else the component's; always closed while disabled or read-only (docs/combobox-readonly.md:14-19).
endState.behaviour: open: notified once per change caused by the reader (focus, click, ArrowDown/ArrowUp, typing, Escape, Tab, blur, outside press, option selection) and by a form reset that closed an open popup; never when the application changes the prop. Controlled and ignored: the DOM keeps the application's value. query: notified once for every input event the component accepted (not blocked, not composing in Angular and vanilla as today) with the input text; selecting an option, a reset and application writes do not notify query (value notification covers them). Angular valueChange fires only when the value changed (today it fires on every keystroke, forms.ts:184). In Angular and like React and Vue, a value written by the application no longer closes an open popup. Server rendering: `defaultOpen` / `open` render the list open on the server and identically on the client; no listener is attached on the server.

items.summary: After a native reset the Angular MultiSelect still submits its old hidden inputs and the Angular FileDropzone still lists files the input no longer holds; no reset listener exists there. The one mechanism of convention native-form-reset (canonical item fields-basic-8, written by forms-core) is applied to the eight controls of this cluster in the four adapters: reset target, one notification only when the value changed, and secondary state cleared.

surface.react: No new prop. Behaviour of existing ones: onValueChange / onFilesChange / onVisibleChange / onOpenChange fire once after a reset that changed their state, also when the value is controlled.
surface.vue: No new prop. update:modelValue / update:files / update:visible / update:open are emitted once and only when the reset changed the state (FileDropzone and FileUpload no longer emit update:files([]) for an already empty control).
surface.angular: No new input (no defaultValue). Without Angular Forms the target is the value held after the first ngOnInit; valueChange (and visibleChange / openChange) fire once when changed.
surface.vanilla: No new option. hw:change and onValueChange now also fire after a reset that changed the value (today they do not).

endState.dom: After the reset microtask, per control: Combobox: text = label of the target option, hidden input = target, popup closed; PasswordField: type=password, toggle aria-pressed=false; SearchField: suggestions closed; PinInput: text = normalised target; TagInput: chips and hidden inputs = target, draft empty; MultiSelect: checkboxes and hidden inputs = target, filter empty, results status empty; FileDropzone: no files, status empty, rejection message removed, data-state not 'error'; FileUpload: no files. aria-invalid set by a failed submission or a rejection is removed.
endState.behaviour: Reset targets: React and Vue `defaultValue` else '' / [] ; FileDropzone and FileUpload []; Angular per convention (Angular Forms attached: nothing written by the component; else the initial value); vanilla the authored values captured at creation. Arrays are compared by content. `visible` of PasswordField always returns to false (also when React defaultVisible is true). Read-only and disabled controls reset too. Controlled and ignored: text, checked state and hidden inputs are rewritten from the application's value. Focus stays where it is (the reset button). No listener is attached during server rendering (observeFormReset is created after mount).

items.summary: A mixed batch and several files on a single-file dropzone give three different outcomes, and two adapters drop extra files silently. One core function evaluates a batch and the four adapters apply one rule: a batch replaces the selection, and a batch with any rejected file leaves the dropzone empty and reports every rejected file.

endState.behaviour: For a batch from the chooser or a drop, when the control is available: result = evaluateFileSelection(batch, {accept, multiple, maxSize}). Rejected (result.rejected not empty): the native input is cleared (input.value = ''), the held value becomes [], the reject notification fires once with result.rejected, the value notification fires with [] only if files were held before. Accepted: on a drop the drop's own FileList is assigned (input.files = event.dataTransfer.files, no DataTransfer construction), the held value becomes the batch, the rejection state is cleared and the value notification fires; if the browser refuses the assignment the frameworks leave the selection unchanged and notify nothing (vanilla shows unsupportedDropMessage). Rejection reasons: 'count' for every file of a batch of more than one when `multiple` is off; else per file 'type' when it does not match `accept`, else 'size' when it exceeds maxSize. Keyboard and focus unchanged. Server rendering: the function is pure; nothing runs on the server.
